_comment: Declarative building presets for the agent map-editing tools (EditBuild.AgentMcp.js).
A preset is a list of parts; each part is a shape from EditGeometry.AgentMcp.js plus a
material name from `materials` below. Values written as "$name" are taken from the call's
`params`, so one preset covers many sizes ("-$name" reads a parameter negated). Geometry
is relative to the origin tile the agent gives, and rotation is applied around that origin.
- Every id here is read from the game cache (`search_objects`, which names come from
CacheDefinitions, or `yarn dump:loc`), never from another server or from memory. An id
that stops existing after a cache update shows up as a failed placement, not as silent
corruption, and `search_objects` re-derives the right one by name.
- The `about` notes describe APPEARANCE only, and were checked in-game with the
vision_screenshot tool on a headless client. They are not claims about game behaviour.
Objects that looked wrong in the world are listed in server/docs/agents/map-editing.md
(Marble wall 5907 and Tower 1939 render as brown wood; 3x3 Pillar 6283 and Column 5228
render as oversized dark monoliths). Add new materials here rather than hard-coding

castle_wall.about: Grey crenellated stone wall; renders as proper stone (checked in-game)

battlement.about: Squat crenellated stone block; stacks into towers and parapets

house.about: Walled house shell with a doorway; hollow, so it can be furnished.

tower.about: Square tower footprint with a parapet ring around it.

gatehouse.about: Gate flanked by battlement piers, with an archway behind it.

plaza.about: Open square: king statues at the corners, braziers mid-side, marble benches inside.

tiered_city.about: Ringed hill city: four concentric walls, each with an east gate and towers on its east and west sides. Pair with set_height terraces for the stepped look.
